_comment: Promoted submissions to the attest-challenge benchmark. Written by the Yukon sync workflow. `baseline` is the reference number the challenge opened on, measured on the held-out split by the detector currently driving published verdicts.
baseline_note: attest-fyi's shipped rule, unchanged: it catches 12 of 14 substitutions and falsely accuses 4 of 8 honest pairs, so the run is rejected and it scores zero. Honest pairs measure 0.420-0.551 similarity across independent sampling sessions and swaps 0.330-0.490, so the distributions overlap and no threshold on a mean separates them.
